request.message:
aihub#285: correct the stale worktree path format in IR1

IR1's illustration said `pf.<shortid>/<repo>/`. internal/cli/doctor.go documents
that as the legacy layout; the live producers (internal/mcp/tools_lifecycle.go:440
and internal/coding/scenario.go:48) both emit `pf.<project>-<seq>`, which is also
what .polyforge/usage.md already states.

Before this branch, iron-rules.md sat past the hook payload's truncation cut, so
the stale string never reached a session. Promoting the fragment to the front of
the payload makes it visible, so it has to be right — otherwise a reader now sees
two prominent, contradictory worktree paths in one context.

repo-routing.md carries the same stale string but is owned by another in-flight
branch, which has already corrected it there.

Payload 9750 -> 9756 chars, still under the 9800 gate; the payload test suite
passes end to end including its negative control.
